text:
carmen: quick sketch idea — Permission Ribbons: each role gets a thin horizontal ribbon that surfaces top 3 permissions as chips, primary CTA (Invite) and a tiny 'audit' crayon icon. aim: reduce column noise and speed invites for admins

dmitri: sounds promising. two product questions: how do we handle deep-perm visibility and SSO state?

carmen: deep perms behind a chevron expand. SSO shown as a passive "SSO org-wide" sentinel on the org header; per-role SSO toggle is not supported so we shouldn't show interactive toggles in ribbons.

tess: a11y notes: ribbons should be a single focusable row (role=listitem) with aria-label combining name + member count + short perms: e.g., "Support Role  6 members  top perms: escalate incidents, view logs, run queries". expand control needs aria-expanded and the expanded panel role=region with aria-labelledby.

alyssa: microcopy idea for SSO sentinel tooltip: "Organization SSO is enabled  all users must sign in via SSO. Manage in Organization settings." keeps clarity when customers wonder why per-role toggle disabled.

dmitri: implementation caveat: virtualization + expandable rows require stable heights. prefer lazy-rendering expanded content and using a height-reservation placeholder to avoid list jumps. Marco (cc) can prototype.

sam: audit UX: clicking the small crayon icon should open an inline timeline popover (not a full nav) with latest 8 events and a link to full audit. ensure that popover is keyboard-trappable and has role=dialog with aria-label="Audit for <role>". closing returns focus to the crayon.

carmen: also thinking about the invite microflow: clicking Invite in ribbon opens a lightweight drawer anchored to the ribbon with email input, role presets, and a small template picker. keyboard flow: Ribbon focus -> Enter -> Drawer opens -> first input focused. Esc closes and returns focus to ribbon. include SR toast: "Invite drawer opened for <role>".

tess: contrast & hit targets: chips must meet AA; ensure small icon-only buttons are 44x44 in compact mode. also ensure tooltips are accessible via keyboard (aria-describedby) and not only hover.

alyssa: product decision: agreed to keep SSO sentinel passive. prefer templates in invite drawer. also request: audit popover should show a compact diff summary if template applied. avoids noise.

dmitri: action items: carmen - add ribbon mocks for comfy/compact and include sentinel; tess - write SR aria-label templates and focus-return rules; marco - prototype lazy-render placeholder for expanded rows; sam - define audit popover data shape (max 8 items + link). review Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
